Abstraksi

Provinsi Jawa Barat Dalam Angka merupakan publikasi BPS Provinsi Jawa Barat yang menyajikan beragam jenis data yang bersumber dari BPS dan institusi lain. Publikasi ini memuat gambaran umum tentang keadaan geografi dan iklim, pemerintahan, serta perkembangan kondisi sosial-demografi dan perekonomian di Provinsi Jawa Barat. Beberapa tabel tertentu menyajikan data pada tingkat provinsi dan kabupaten/kota untuk melihat perbandingan antar wilayah. Untuk memudahkan pemahaman dan pemanfaatan data, disertakan juga penjelasan teknis dari setiap jenis statistik yang disajikan. Implementasi Sistem Informasi Manajemen Data Statistik Terintegrasi (SIMDASI) dilakukan dalam penyusunan Publikasi Provinsi Jawa Barat Dalam Angka 2024 untuk mendukung terciptanya Satu Data Indonesia. Seiring dengan meningkatnya kebutuhan konsumen data, publikasi ini akan terus mengalami penyempurnaan baik struktur maupun muatannya.

series.name: Area of critical-land rehabilitation / tree planting
series.concept: Environmental response activity; not ecosystem state
series.directionExplanation: More reported planting can reflect more restoration effort, more pre-existing damage, program budgets or land availability. It does not measure residual environmental pressure.

source.table: Luas Rehabilitasi Lahan Kritis/Penanaman Pohon Berdasarkan Kabupaten/Kota di Jawa Barat

series.comparability: BPS2019 kabupaten/kota code matching only. Published names/codes do not establish common spatial mapping, denominator or ecological class equivalence.
series.reportingBias: Administrative reporting scope and effort affect records; absent records are not zero.
series.redundancy: Do not add this contextual quantity to IKL/IKLH as an independent quality-pressure dimension without a causal and measurement redundancy check.
caveats: 27/27 published2023 district rows. Published zeros remain observed zeros for activity only.
Numerator combines critical-land rehabilitation and tree planting. No survival, species, planting-density, baseline degraded-area, repeat-treatment or achieved-cover definition accompanies rows.
No verified same-year district-area or eligible-degraded-land denominator. Dividing by district area would not resolve activity-versus-state direction.
Administrative totals do not establish mutually exclusive parcels or common satellite land-cover classification.

recommendation.reason: Complete activity panel is useful context, but fails state-construct and monotonic pressure-direction gates.

series.name: Reported community forest area / luas hutan rakyat
series.concept: Partial land ecosystem stock; neither all forest cover nor land degradation
series.directionExplanation: More community forest is not unconditionally better ambient condition. Absolute area reflects district size, rural land availability, tenure and plantation management.

source.table: Luas Hutan Rakyat Berdasarkan Kabupaten/Kota di Jawa Barat

series.comparability: BPS2019 kabupaten/kota code matching only. Published names/codes do not establish common spatial mapping, denominator or ecological class equivalence.
series.reportingBias: Administrative reporting scope and effort affect records; absent records are not zero.
series.redundancy: Do not add this contextual quantity to IKL/IKLH as an independent quality-pressure dimension without a causal and measurement redundancy check.
caveats: Hutan rakyat is a producer-defined subset, not complete remote-sensing vegetation/tree/forest cover. Metadata lacks canopy threshold, species/plantation split, reference-map scale, geometric boundary version and accuracy.
No verified co-registered2023 land-area denominator. A share cannot be constructed from unrelated area tables safely.
Raw hectare ranking structurally favors large rural kabupaten over dense kota; cultivation and designated forest classes cannot be added without overlap rules.

recommendation.reason: Retain official2023 quantity as context only; insufficient ecological-class, denominator and measurement equivalence for pressure scoring.

observations.missingReason: No2023 row for this district; KotaBandung omitted. Never infer zero.

series.concept: Reported pollution occurrence, not laboratory surface-water quality

source.table: Jumlah Desa Berdasarkan Kondisi Pencemaran Air di Jawa Barat

series.comparability: BPS2019 kabupaten/kota code matching only. Published names/codes do not establish common spatial mapping, denominator or ecological class equivalence.

caveats: 19/27 districts: all18 kabupaten and KotaBanjar. Eight other kota missing, not zero.

The source does not identify river/waterbody, pollutant, concentration, severity, sampling date, monitoring site, threshold or source-attribution rule.
No independently reconciled administrative village denominator is supplied. Counts may reflect population of reporting villages and detection/reporting practices.
The village-level sibling dataset19594 does not provide a valid2023 cross-check through the inspected API; do not silently merge.

recommendation.reason: Useful qualitative-reporting context only. It lacks eight cities and does not meet ambient measurement, monitoring geography or reporting completeness gates.

findings: Absolute forest/park area favors larger ruralkabupaten and penalizes densekota even without worse ecological management. A total-area fraction can still reflect coast, mountains, agriculture and legal allocation rather than degradation.

Community forest, legal forest designation, actual canopy, plantations, critical land, mangroves, biodiversity parks and public open space are distinct classes. They cannot be added without mutually exclusive mappings.
Normalizing by unrelatedBPSarea is insufficient: boundary year, land-versus-water mask, eligible ecosystem opportunity, reference-map scale and classification must match numerator.

BNPBIRBI2023methodologyp20 explicitly includes environmental damage inhectares among consequences/vulnerability parameters. This establishes conceptual contact with land ecosystem stocks, not identity with ambient environmental quality.
[INFERENCE]More ecologically valuable stock can mean better ecosystem condition but more environmental assets exposed to a given hazard; pressure and vulnerability directions need not match.
No empirical duplicate-correlation claim is made because a comparable2023land-state panel and IRBIenvironmental subcomponent were not reconstructed.
